user.title: Provider
user.description: Smart LLM connects Home Assistant Assist to a pluggable language model. This version supports Cursor.

menu_option_descriptions.cursor: Sign in with Cursor in your browser, then answer Assist through Cursor Bridge.

cursor_link.title: Authorize Cursor

data_description.login_url: Copy this if the link above is hard to select. Editing it has no effect.

cursor_model.title: Model
cursor_model.description: Signed in as {account}. Stored API key: {masked_key}. Requests go to Cursor Bridge at {bridge_base_url}. Cursor Bridge is unofficial community software; the operator of that URL can see prompts you send.

data.acknowledge_bridge: I understand Cursor Bridge is unofficial

data_description.bridge_base_url: OpenAI-compatible base URL. The default is https://cursorbridge.dev/v1.
data_description.model: Model id from Cursor Bridge. Use default to let Cursor choose.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Optional. Exposes the selected Home Assistant tools to the model.
data_description.prompt: Added after the built-in Assist prompt.
data_description.acknowledge_bridge: Required before the API key is stored.

progress.authorize: Waiting for browser approval. Login URL: {login_url}

error.timeout: Authorization timed out. Start again and approve the login in your browser.
error.invalid_auth: Cursor rejected the login or the API key.
error.mint_failed: Login succeeded, but creating an API key failed. Team settings may restrict user API keys.
error.unknown: Something went wrong during Cursor login.
error.invalid_url: Enter an http or https URL without embedded credentials.
error.invalid_model: Enter a model id without spaces.
error.no_models: Could not load models. You can still type a model id such as default.
error.bridge_not_acknowledged: Confirm that you understand Cursor Bridge is an unofficial service.

abort.already_configured: This Cursor account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: That Cursor account does not match this integration entry.

menu_option_descriptions.settings: Choose the model, Cursor Bridge URL, Assist tools, and extra instructions.
menu_option_descriptions.refresh_models: Call GET /v1/models on the configured Cursor Bridge URL.
menu_option_descriptions.reauth: Open the Cursor login page and mint a new API key.
menu_option_descriptions.logout: Remove the stored API key from Home Assistant.

settings.title: Model and Bridge URL
settings.description: Account: {account}. API key: {masked_key}. Cursor Bridge ({bridge_base_url}) is unofficial community software. The operator of that URL can see prompts you send.

data_description.bridge_base_url: OpenAI-compatible base URL. The default is https://cursorbridge.dev/v1.

data_description.prompt: Added after the built-in Assist prompt. Leave empty to remove extra instructions.

cursor_link.description:
Open this URL and approve access. The previous key is replaced only after a new key is minted.

logout.title: Log out
logout.description: This removes the stored API key for {account} ({masked_key}) from Home Assistant. The key remains valid in the Cursor dashboard until it expires or you revoke it there.
